author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Artificial-intelligence startup Discovery Loop is seeking new funding at a valuation of about $50 billion, Business Insider reported, citing people familiar with the discussions. The terms could change and there is no guarantee the talks will result in a transaction, making the figure an indication of investor negotiations rather than a completed valuation.

The reported target represents an unusually rapid increase for a company launched this year. Discovery Loop was in talks last month to raise about $1 billion at a valuation near $10 billion, according to the report. The startup is structured as a public benefit corporation and is focused on using machine learning for scientific and engineering research.

Its founding team includes prominent artificial-intelligence and engineering leaders, including longtime Google researcher Jeff Dean. The fundraising effort reflects continued investor appetite for teams with established AI credentials even as spending requirements and commercialization timelines remain uncertain. Discovery Loop did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment, and no investors or final financing amount were confirmed.
dek: The young AI research startup is pursuing a sharp valuation increase, according to Business Insider, though terms could change and a deal is not assured.
headline: Discovery Loop seeks funding at reported $50 billion valuation
